features.name: Campsite host start and stop
features.purpose: Use an Android phone as a nearby Campsite host so guests can join a local session from their browsers.
features.guideLabel: Read the related customer guide
features.current: The dated phone records confirm bounded host start, guest lobby join and leave, and host Stop checks. These are recorded scenarios on the named older test builds, not proof that every route works in the current build.
features.requirements: An Android host with Beebo installed, and nearby guest devices with a browser on the same reachable local network. Download intended media before travel. Keep the host charged and awake; undownloaded media still needs its source computer reachable.
steps: Open Campsite Mode from the tent icon, Play, or More → Campsite & Wi-Fi; wording can differ by build.
Choose Invite guests and the local Wi-Fi option suitable for your phones. Existing shared Wi-Fi is one supported setup route; check the known limits before relying on hotspot modes.
Have guests join the host’s local Wi-Fi, then open the theatre code or address shown by the host. They do not need a separate Beebo account for this guest flow.
Keep the host nearby, awake and powered while guests are connected.
When finished, choose Stop and confirm Stop on the host.
limits: Four known issues remain open; this page keeps the reviewed 90% score.
Temporary-network use with a SIM-equipped guest, hotspot behavior and older stop failures still need matching checks.
Some shared networks prevent nearby devices from reaching each other. Hotspot options vary by phone.
The host’s own guest-video browser page can count as a guest. Host start and stop checks do not prove all game, sound or multi-guest behavior.
